swingContinuity: 최근 며칠간 QQQ의 매수/매도 점수는 59/27, 59/24, 55/18로 점진적인 매도 압력 감소 흐름을 보였으며, 9월8일(화, 뉴욕) 56/24로 소폭 반등하며 매수세가 유지되는 구간으로 진입했습니다. 특히 SOXX와 TSLA가 최근 5거래일 동안 각각 +1.51%, +3.91%로 강한 상승세를 보인 반면, QQQ는 +0.23%, +0.18%로 상대적으로 약한 흐름을 나타냈습니다.
swingContinuityEn: QQQ's buy/sell scores showed a trend of gradually decreasing selling pressure over the past few days, moving from 59/27 to 59/24 and then to 55/18. Today, the score rebounded slightly to 56/24, entering a zone where buying sentiment is maintained. Notably, while SOXX and TSLA showed strong gains of +1.51% and +3.91% respectively over the last five trading days, QQQ exhibited a relatively weaker trend with +0.23% and +0.18%.
